violation_type.title: Special Diets - Discuss Eating Problems With Parents (26 TAC §746.3311(b))
violation_type.short_title: Special Diets - Discuss Eating Problems With Parents
violation_type.typical_finding: A child that was enrolled in the after-school program did not want to eat breakfast or lunch that was offered to him.  This was not communicated to the parent until the following day.
